verdict.rationale: Payroll and HR platforms commonly handle signed onboarding and compliance documents, so a tamper-evident audit trail is a fair question for Gusto. The evidence pack never documents an audit trail or completion certificate for signed documents. The webhook catalog listing 'signatory' and 'document' events is an adjacent developer building block, not this capability.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, I can rely on a tamper-evident audit trail and completion certificate for every signed document
